name: pixel-agents-mcp-bridge
description: MCP server that surfaces Claude Desktop activity to the Pixel Office IntelliJ plugin via a shared JSONL log

scripts.build:server: tsc && esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=server/index.mjs --define:__BRIDGE_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\" --banner:js="import { createRequire as _cr } from 'node:module'; const require = _cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:web: (cd ../webview-ui && npm run build) && rm -rf web && mkdir -p web && cp -R ../dist/webview/. web/
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.pack: npm run build && rm -f pixel-agents-bridge-*.mcpb && ./node_modules/.bin/mcpb pack . pixel-agents-bridge-$npm_package_version.mcpb
